trial._comment: One free trial per business, opt-in from Billing. No card, nothing charged; the effective plan reverts to the base plan when the window closes.

cors._comment: CORS allow-list used when CORS_ORIGINS env is unset. Production refuses to start if both are empty.

platform._comment: In-app product-owner console (/platform/*). Overridden by COOP_PLATFORM_ADMINS; email match is case-insensitive. Empty list = console closed.

licensing._comment: Signed activation keys (PRD Ch7 §7.19). The signing key lives ONLY in LICENSE_SIGNING_KEY and admin tokens in LICENSE_ADMIN_TOKENS — neither belongs in this file.

resend._comment: Resend API email (preferred over SMTP). Put the key in RESEND_API_KEY (env), never here. onboarding@resend.dev only delivers to your own account email - use a verified domain address for real sending.

feedback._comment: Where in-app product feedback is emailed. FEEDBACK_INBOX (env) overrides this. Empty = feedback is stored but not emailed.

rate_limits._comment: Per-tenant limits for the expensive non-AI endpoints. requests <= 0 disables a section.

paystack._comment: Paystack. Charges go through the API (POST /transaction/initialize) using prices_kobo, so PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY is REQUIRED - without it no checkout can start and no webhook can be verified. Currency is NGN and amounts are in kobo: starter N9,500/mo (N91,200/yr), professional N29,000/mo (N278,400/yr) - both 20% off annual, matching frontend/src/billing/plans.ts. These sit inside the observed Nigerian SME band (generic POS N5,000-20,000; Fisco Pro N10,000; Odoo POS+Inventory N37,500-55,500) - see docs/BUSINESS_PLAN.md section 5. Enterprise has no price on purpose: it is Contact Sales. Set paystack.callback_url (or the PAYSTACK_CALLBACK_URL env var) to the absolute URL of the deployed Billing page.
